skills.name: Steel Bones
skills.desc: Gatotkaca gains Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 200). For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100). Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal extra Magic Damage and recover HP. The extra damage scales with his Rage, level, and Magic Power.

skills.name: Blast Iron Fist
skills.desc: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second and be slowed by 30%.

skills.name: Unbreakable
skills.desc: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, taunting enemies on the path to attack him, dealing 200 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 0.9 - 1.5s. The taunt duration and sprint distance scale with the channel time. Canceling the skill reduces 50% of the remaining cooldown.

skills.name: Avatar of the Guardian
skills.desc: Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500 (+300% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1s. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center. The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.
